nsight.interpretation: Four complete cold/warm/warm-repeat/changed calls. API times cover the entire endpoint and overlap GPU execution: do not add them to kernel durations. Device event tracing and shared-node profiling can perturb timing; these samples are not a speed comparison with n1. Every weighted ERI kernel uses the existing per-consumer stream, so its stream memcpy totals isolate derivative input/results. Nsight launch counts independently match the n1 consumer census.
limitations: Nsight warned that device-side CUDA event completion tracing was enabled and may add runtime overhead/false stream dependencies.
Raw Nsight artifacts remain ignored locally and on n2; selected aggregates and SHA256 are retained here.

phase_interpretation.conventional_derivative: Four disjoint intervals: rank-two pullback, one-electron (including nuclear repulsion), ERI shell callbacks, remaining AO pullback/scatter/bookkeeping. These all nest inside derivative_ns.
phase_interpretation.cuda_conventional_derivative: consumer_ns nests inside shell callbacks; includes existing primitive consumer stream allocation/upload/kernel/download/synchronization/destruction, excludes caller-side primitive record construction.
phase_interpretation.raw_source_read_ns: Submission time on CUDA; not completed integral time. raw_provider_ns and raw_source_read_ns nest inside raw_hamiltonian_ns.
phase_interpretation.relaxed_cc_force_completed: Five disjoint outer phase intervals exclude preceding energy, admission and cleanup. Scope itself is emitted only after successful force calculation; its elapsed_ms is emission overhead, not force time.
phase_interpretation.units: Integer nanoseconds and executed semantic counts. No added CUDA fence; disabled traces avoid new clock reads.

qualification.non_cuda_compile: All three modified post-HF translation units compiled with GENERATIVEQC_HAS_CUDA=0 using ccache.
